scope: First-party text API rates, short prompts; representative models, not an exhaustive catalog. Rates verified from fetched official pages.
replay_assumptions: No paid API calls are made.
Cache-miss input and actual output token counts only; no cache hits, cache writes, tools, taxes, residency surcharges, enterprise discounts, or free credits.
Identical numeric token quantities are replayed across tariffs. Tokenizers and output lengths differ on real text; this is not a same-task benchmark.
Provider model quality, capacity, latency, batching implementation, and SLOs are not simulated by invoice replay.
Simulator reserve 0.001 per token equals $1000 per million tokens; its money scale is illustrative, not calibrated to provider rates.
